entries.reason: The compact editor consumes the same authored rich-block/media/table typography and rendering rules; its geometry and controls remain component-owned.
Virtualized grid, row/column/cell sizing, selection, drag feedback and inline editing geometry; ordinary controls belong to React owners.
Board scroll/virtual-item and inline card-cell sizing under the actual workspace; card and column chrome belong to React owners.
Inline editor/cell coupling and visibility geometry; picker, date and option controls belong to their owners.
Readonly authored field-value typography, tag/progress/person data rendering under its actual palette boundary.
Private field-color enum bindings to canonical nearest-theme roles; no chrome layout or control styles.
The home root owns the same private field palette contract; all layout and actions are component-owned.
Canvas/raster positioning, camera grid, selection, resize, inline text, minimap and anchored hit geometry; ordinary chrome and overlay-control visuals belong to React owners.
Virtualized grid/cell sizing, editing/focus coupling and grouped-row geometry; menus, cards and record forms belong to React owners.
Read-only snapshot table and scroll geometry under its actual data-table root; header and pagination belong to React owners.
Authored ProseMirror typography, tables, media and content-visibility/caret rendering; toolbar, outline and loading controls belong to their owners.
Authored rich-block node-view typography, grid layout, counters and pane content; property controls and tabs belong to React owners.
Authored callout/card/step/code typography and content layout; tab and copy controls belong to React owners.
ProseMirror block selection, target and drag feedback applied to authored nodes; menus, handles, drop indicators and drag-preview chrome belong to their owners.
Generated SVG sizing inside the transformed board preview; preview controls and embed chrome belong to React owners.
Authored document typography shared by the editor and published reader; ordinary application chrome is excluded.
Authored Tiptap/prose/media content; box geometry belongs to the QuickNoteEditor owner.
Reader-local theme variables and authored reading aliases; no chrome layout or controls.
Published reader authored prose only; header/navigation/search and other chrome belong to React owners.
